clauses.scope_note: Section 4.2(1): the user retains any rights, title, and interests—if any—in Inputs the user submits. This recognizes retained rights and does not create rights the user does not have.
clauses.condition_explanation: Subject to applicable law and the Terms, the statement concerns only rights, if any, in Inputs submitted by the user.

clauses.scope_note: Section 4.2(2): DeepSeek assigns to the user any rights, title, and interests—if any—in the Services' Outputs. The assignment does not extend to other users' Outputs. Outputs may not be unique, and other users may receive similar Outputs.
clauses.condition_explanation: The assignment is subject to applicable law and the Terms, covers only rights DeepSeek has, if any, in Outputs of the Services, and excludes other users' Outputs. Similarity to another user's Output is not itself stated as an exclusion.
